scope: Dynamic composition uses reviewed guide stops only and is evaluated beside reviewed anchor routes; neither source can bypass reviewed space data.

duration_policy.anchor_template_rule: Reviewed anchors and dynamic compositions enter the same strict-budget candidate evaluation for every supported duration.

scoring_policy.notes: Cultural density is primary; visitor interest, craft diversity, detour cost and time continuity also affect selection.

experience_budget_per_stop_seconds.notes: Standard-detail baseline. Each guide stop reserves guide, observation and interaction time; routes are not walking-only.

selection_policy.notes: Initial v1 weights are auditable tuning parameters, not permanent facts. All candidates must satisfy the strict requested-time budget before scoring.

exit_policy.notes: The exit is in the front courtyard. Include reviewed return walking time after the final guide stop.
